about: Proposal TC-02 (p4 l.140-143) offline replay. Provider responses for the Japan set, shaped like the real APIs the app parses (Google Geocoding and Places (New), Open-Meteo geocoding/forecast/archive, Nominatim jsonv2 with namedetails, Wikivoyage parse API, DeepSeek search) and deliberately fragmented: missing fields, the same place under Japanese and English names across sources, conflicting coordinates and partial failures. Values are constructed from the parsers and the providers' public documentation, not downloaded. `truth` lists the real places each city's rows describe.
